title: '176' is two different elements
description: TRN-176 (Hervanta node) and RAD-176 (Rovaniemi radio) share a number. A NOC operator says '176' and a radio specialist answers about the other one. Tests the over-linking guard: the tip belongs to RAD-176 and must not be attached to TRN-176 nor to the Rovaniemi exchange.
subject: #radio-field

messages.text: random q. 176 keeps showing a link margin warning on cold mornings, is that known?
hm. then I was thinking of the other 176
oh there are two 176s 😅 go on
on that RU-200 the margin dips on hard frost mornings. below minus 25
it comes back on its own when the heater has warmed the unit, about 20 min. don't go up and realign the antenna. ask me how I know. three times
+1 for not realigning. wasted a trip to Ounasvaara in January 😅
good to know. so for the Hervanta 176 I need to look elsewhere. will check the dashboard

items.summary: On RAD-176 (RU-200, Ounasvaara) the link margin dips on hard frost mornings (below -25 C) and recovers by itself in about 20 minutes once the heater has warmed the unit; do not realign the antenna.
items.diagnosis: cold unit, margin recovers after the heater warms it
items.action: Wait about 20 minutes and re-check the link margin.
items.evidence: seq 7-8: 'comes back on its own when the heater has warmed the unit, about 20 min'
